title: Map Studio RPC: mods
description: Named mods and sharing (devdocs/map_studio/S6_PLAN.md item M): projects' builds packed into a mod folder (mod.yml, the files as the game's packages hold them, the rows of engine tables), a mods folder's mods listed, and a free map number for a new project from the mod's or the world's declared range. Installing into a game's mods folder and switching a mod off stay on the command line (oymap mod install|disable|enable): they write into a player's install.

pack.summary: Packs projects into a mod: `<out>/<id>/` with mod.yml (schema mod.schema.json), the maps' files under worlds/<world>/, and the rows they add to or change in engine tables (tables/<table>.append.txt, .override.txt), so that two mods adding map rows do not clash. With `build` (default true) each project is built first; else each must have a build. `maps` declares the mod's map numbers (mod.yml idRanges.maps); a new map numbered outside it is warned of.

projects.description: The projects whose builds it holds.

id.description: Lower case letters, digits and underscores: the mod's folder.

out.description: A folder for mods. The host maps what a browser names onto its own mods folder ("default"); the core takes the folder as given. The mod is written into <out>/<id>/ (an older pack of the same id replaced).

maps.description: [first, last]: the map numbers the mod declares as its own.

build.description: Build each project first. Default true.

files.description: The mod's files, relative to its folder (mod.yml first).

maps.description: Its maps: new maps and overlays.

tables.description: The engine tables whose rows it carries.

list.summary: The mods of a mods folder: merged installs (the loose folder the game mounts in front of the named mods: studio_mods.yml), named installs and packed mods (<id>/mod.yml), each with its map numbers and declared range.

mods.description: A folder for mods. The host maps what a browser names onto its own mods folder ("default"); the core takes the folder as given.

named.description: Named installs and packed mods (a folder with mod.yml).

map_number.summary: A free map number (map_stats id) for a new project: the first of the range that no map takes. The range is the mod's (`mod`, by its id in `mods`: mod.yml idRanges.maps), else the world's (world.yml idRanges.maps), else the studio's band 9400 to 9999. Taken: the asset root's map_stats rows, every mod in `mods` (and a merged install's composed table), and the map cards of `projects`. Declared ranges that overlap are warned of.

mods.description: A folder for mods. The host maps what a browser names onto its own mods folder ("default"); the core takes the folder as given.

mod.description: The mod the new map belongs to (its id in `mods`).

projects.description: Projects whose map numbers are taken too (the host passes all of its own).

range.description: [first, last] of the range it was taken from.

taken.description: How many numbers of the range are taken.

enabled.description: Merged: whether its files are in the mods folder now. Named: whether enabled.yml lists it (the game mounts the listed ones at its next start; devdocs/NAMED_MODS.md).

files.description: Merged installs: the files it put into the mods folder.

maps.description: Named installs and packed mods: the maps its manifest lists.

map_numbers.description: The map_stats numbers its new maps take.

map_range.description: [first, last]: the map numbers it declares as its own (mod.yml idRanges.maps).
